transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because I just feel worn out all the time. It's like... even after a full night in bed, my body feels like it's made of sandbags. Getting through a workday or just doing something simple like folding laundry takes everything I have. I just don't have any energy left.
Over this same period when you've been feeling so fatigued, how has your mood been? Have you been feeling sad, down, or depressed?

Yeah, I have. It's... well, most days I wake up with this heavy, flat feeling right in my chest. I'll just sit at the kitchen table, staring out at the yard, and... I don't know, I just feel like there is no good version of the future coming. It's just a very down, bleak feeling.
When did you first start noticing this fatigue and low mood? Did it come on gradually over weeks or months, or did it start more suddenly?

It started about two months ago, right around the time we took on our new mortgage. It wasn't really a gradual thing, honestly. My mood just kind of swung. I had been in this really overcharged business push, just going non-stop, and then it just... shifted right into this low stretch. So, yeah, it felt pretty sudden when it happened.

During that time when you were in this 'overcharged business push' that you mentioned—before the mood shifted down—did you feel unusually energized or like you needed less sleep than normal, or did things feel pretty typical for you?

Yeah, I definitely felt unusually energized. It wasn't typical for me at all. I had this... well, this burst where I just could not sit still. I kept jumping up from my desk to sketch out new office layouts, or I'd start reorganizing all my project files. It was like I always had to start just one more task, even when there was no real reason it had to happen right then. I just had all this extra drive to keep moving and doing things.

During that energized period before your mood dropped—when you were feeling overcharged and couldn't sit still—did you notice that you needed significantly less sleep than usual? For example, were you sleeping only a few hours a night but still feeling rested and energized?

No, not really. I mean, I was still sleeping my usual amount, maybe seven or eight hours a night. I didn't feel like I could just run on empty or anything like that. I was just really active during the day when I was awake.
During that period when you felt unusually energized and were jumping from task to task—how many days or weeks did that energized, overcharged feeling last before your mood shifted down?

I'm not exactly sure, honestly. I wasn't really keeping track of the days. It was just a stretch of time where I felt really driven, but I couldn't tell you exactly how many days or weeks it was before I crashed.
When you think back to that time when you felt really energized and driven—jumping from task to task—do you think that lasted for at least 4 or 5 days in a row, or was it more of a day or two?

I honestly can't say for sure. It might have been four or five days, or it might have just been a couple of days. I just know it was a distinct period where I felt that way, but I really didn't track how many days in a row it was.

When you think back to that energized period, even if you're not completely certain—do you remember it feeling like it lasted at least several days in a row, or does it seem more like it was just one or two days?

I really don't know how else to say it. I just don't remember the exact timeframe. It could have been a few days, it could have been just a couple. I just know it happened, but the specific number of days is a blur to me.

Let me ask this differently: During that time when you felt really energized and driven, did you feel that way every single day for at least four days in a row, or were there days mixed in where you felt more normal?

I understand what you're trying to figure out, but I just can't break it down like that. When I look back, it all just sort of runs together. I really don't remember if there were normal days mixed in or if it was constant every single day. I just know I was in that state, but the actual day-to-day details... I just don't have them.
During that energized period, do you remember it being long enough that you would have gone through at least a full work week of feeling that way, or was it shorter than that?

Look, I'm really trying to give you the answer you're looking for, but I just don't know. Like I said, the whole thing is just a blur. I couldn't tell you if it lasted a full work week or if it was shorter. I just remember feeling that way, but the actual amount of time... it's just not something I can pull out of my memory right now.

You mentioned this low mood and fatigue started about two months ago. Since that time, has the depressed mood and lack of energy been present pretty much every day for these past two months, or have there been periods where you felt better?

Yeah, it's been pretty constant. The... the depressed, slowed-down, exhausted part of this has been going on most days for about the past two months. I haven't really had any periods where I felt better.

When you think back to that time before you crashed into the low mood—when you felt energized and couldn't sit still—if you had to make your best guess, do you think that energized feeling lasted for at least 4 days or longer, or do you think it was probably shorter than that?

I know you really need a timeline here, but even if I try to guess, I'd just be making it up. I honestly don't know if it was four days, or less, or more. I... I just remember the feeling of being in that state, but the actual number of days is completely lost to me.

I understand the timeline is fuzzy. Let me ask it this way: during that energized period, do you remember it feeling like something that lasted roughly a week or longer, or does it feel more like it was just a day or two?

I'm sorry, I really wish I could give you a better answer. It's just... I don't know if it was a week, or a day, or two days. I just know I felt that way, and then I crashed. I really can't say how long it lasted.

I know the exact number of days is hard to recall, but thinking back to that energized, driven period—did it feel like something that was noticeable and distinct for several days, or more like just a brief burst that passed quickly?

I really just don't know. I'm sorry, I know you're trying to figure this out, but I genuinely can't tell you if it was several days or just a quick burst. My memory of that time is just... it's just the feeling of it, not the timeframe. I just can't say for sure either way.

During that energized period when you were jumping from task to task and couldn't sit still—do you remember your family, friends, or coworkers noticing that something was different about you, or commenting on how you were acting?
I don't really remember anyone saying anything. I mean, maybe they noticed, but... no one actually made a comment about it to me. At least, not that I can recall right now.

When you think back to that energized period—from the day it started to the day it ended—do you remember it spanning across multiple calendar dates, like from a Monday through a Thursday or longer, or does it feel like it was contained within just one or two days?

I really... I just don't know how else to say it. I can't put a calendar to it. I don't remember if it was a Monday to a Thursday, or just a Tuesday. The whole period is just a blur of feeling wired. I'm sorry, I just don't have a timeline for you.

I know the exact timeline is hard to recall, but let me ask you this: during that energized period when you felt driven and couldn't sit still, do you think it's more likely that you felt that way for at least 4 full days in a row, or do you think it was probably less than that—like 1 to 3 days?

I know you need a specific number, but I honestly couldn't even guess. I mean, if I said it was four days, or if I said it was two, I'd really just be making it up to give you an answer. I don't want to tell you the wrong thing. I just genuinely don't know.

I understand the exact dates are fuzzy. Let me try this a different way: thinking back to that time when you felt energized and driven—if you had to bet your life on it, would you say it's more likely that you felt that way for at least 4 days in a row, or would you bet that it was probably 3 days or less?

Look, even if I had to bet my life on it... I still couldn't tell you. I'm not trying to be difficult, I just... I really don't know. It could have been three days, it could have been five. I just remember feeling that way, but the actual length of time is completely lost to me. I can't give you a guess, because that's all it would be.

When you look back at that energized, driven period—even though you can't pinpoint exact dates—do you have a sense that it was clearly more than just a day or two, or is it possible it might have only lasted a single day or just overnight?

I really don't think it was just a single day or overnight. It definitely felt longer than that. But as for whether it was two days, three days, or more... I just don't have a clear sense of it. I just know it wasn't just a quick, 24-hour thing.

You mentioned that energized period felt longer than just a single day or overnight. When you think about it now, does it feel like it was clearly a stretch of time that lasted multiple days—like you could count it as 2, 3, or more separate days—or does it feel more vague than that, like it might have just been one intense day that felt extended?

I know it was definitely multiple days. It wasn't just one intense day that stretched out. I can say for sure it was a stretch of time, like... a few days at least. I just can't tell you exactly how many.
